technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 和 [Q05](#research-q05)：novelty 9/35（25%）把既有屏幕范围和别名结合，非新安全原理，高于零但不足50%；mechanism 15/30（50%）实时偏好和动态映射改变目标失效边界，但未验证完整 native 安全，不达75%；transferability 5/20（25%）别名映射可借鉴但依赖原生注册表，未证跨平台，不达50%；simplification 4/15（25%）别名减少硬编码，但仍需权限和运行维护，不达50%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q04](#research-q04)：workflow 18/35（50%）将 DSH 与设备动作带入手机，改变工作地点，但真实效率未测不达75%；delivery 8/30（25%）潜在实现移动任务，任务可靠性未验证不达50%；reach 5/20（25%）可触及手机使用者但未证明新增用户群，不达50%；economics 4/15（25%）便携可能节省切换，电耗、维护和模型成本未知，不达50%。

recommendation.reason: 移动场景可在隔离设备评估；完整 APK 原生路径、恢复和设备兼容性未实测，先备份并保留退路。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) README.en.md:16-29 确定手机 AI 与设备操作需求，超过8分的潜在用途；使用频率与重复摩擦未验证，低于23分。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) screen-scope.ts:1232-1255 与 index.ts:759-780 提供范围及动态目标，超过6分包装；native 和真实收益未测，低于19分。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 两处桥源码及 [Q03](#research-q03) README.en.md:101-105 覆盖代表实现与构建边界，超过6分单一声明；未运行设备和完整 APK，低于19分。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) README.en.md:23-29、78-82 列出权限、电池与可选依赖，且可退回桌面，超过5分无明确退路；恢复一致性和电耗未知，低于15分。

# DSH Mobile APK > 把 DSH 与设备控制交互带到 Android 手机。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk](https://github.com/kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk) - **版本号**：未声明（[固定提交 664376fde91af8a4cff3555a7d563ac999bc142f](https://github.com/kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk/tree/664376fde91af8a4cff3555a7d563ac999bc142f)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-01（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定根仓静态核查桥接和文档；未运行 APK、Shizuku 或设备。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要在手机上使用 DSH 并按需控制设备的用户。 - **亮点**：[Q02](#research-q02) 以用户范围与动态屏幕映射连接设备工具；不证明系统级沙箱。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 本次未核查完整 native 构建，不能从桥代码推断 APK 全路径安全。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 在现有状态入口附带受控探针时间和目标可帮助用户决定启用或重试；对照如无改善、误导或成本抵消收益即否定。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 在隔离设备先验证权限、会话恢复并备份，保留桌面退路。 ## 核心贡献 [Q02](#research-q02) 以用户范围与动态屏幕映射连接设备工具；不证明系统级沙箱。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 本次未核查完整 native 构建，不能从桥代码推断 APK 全路径安全。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 在现有状态入口附带受控探针时间和目标可帮助用户决定启用或重试；对照如无改善、误导或成本抵消收益即否定。 对照现有状态入口与增加探针展示，测试权限撤销、注册表变化和超时，测错误启用/重试、误判、时延与电耗；另核查完整 native。 ## 场景与替代办法 需要在手机上使用 DSH 并按需控制设备的用户。 桌面 DSH、远程网页和 Android 手动操作可完成部分任务，无需手机本地运行环境。 ## 依赖与流程 | 条件 | 用途 | 不满足时 | |---|---|---| | Android 和可用 DSH 环境 | 移动运行 | 无法按此路径使用 | | 无障碍及用户允许实屏 | 物理屏操作 | 实屏能力受限 | | Shizuku | 虚拟屏和特权操作 | 高级能力不可用 | [Q01](#research-q01) 安装和配置后在手机发起任务，按用户授权访问设备。 ## 成本与效果 [Q04](#research-q04) 权限、后台电池、可选 Shizuku、模型和恢复维护均有成本。 [Q01](#research-q01) 潜在移动场景便利；[Q03](#research-q03) 设备与安全效果未实测。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核对手机能力、屏幕目标边界、依赖和静态证据局限。 ### Q01 · 手机本地运行给谁带来什么，与远程网页相比？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 项目面向希望在 Android 手机工作并让 AI 操作设备的用户。README 描述本地运行与通知回复，远程网页或桌面连接已有相似交互但不必在手机维护运行环境；本地便携的真实收益和经常使用频次未知。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[README.en.md:16-29](https://github.com/kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk/blob/664376fde91af8a4cff3555a7d563ac999bc142f/README.en.md#L16-L29) 产品能力由作者描述。
查看原文（14行） ```text > This project is open source under the MIT License. Forks, modifications, and redistribution are welcome. Contributions, suggestions, and feedback are appreciated. > Judge AI-generated content and actions yourself; experimental features are labeled as such. ## What it can do - **Real bash**: commands the AI runs actually execute in the built-in Termux environment — not simulated output. - **Runs in the background, self-recovers**: lock the screen or switch apps and tasks keep running; the engine is watchdogged and relaunched when it wedges, and comes back on its own after a reboot. Background use drains more battery than an average app — allow "ignore battery optimizations" when the app guides you to. - **AI browser** (experimental): the AI opens and drives web pages in a separate window whose cookies and logins are fully isolated from your daily browser — it never touches your accounts. - **Virtual display** (experimental, needs Shizuku): the AI launches and operates third-party apps on a separate virtual screen without taking over yours, and you can watch it work in a floating window. - **Phone control**: after you grant accessibility, the AI can read the screen and tap, swipe, type and screenshot for you on a real phone. By default only the virtual screen is allowed — touching the real screen requires you to widen the scope in settings. - **Notification replies & approvals**: the AI's questions and approvals land in the notification shade; reply, pick options, approve or deny without switching back to the app (Android 13+ requires allowing notifications in system settings). - **Floating bubble**: a desktop bubble shows live progress; expand the panel to answer the AI's questions and read task reports; triple-tap the status line to jump back into the app. Hide it any time. - **Stable & self-healing**: a broken plugin that wrecks the page is auto-removed and the engine restarts within a minute; safe mode starts the app on a minimal setup for repair; startup failures get a repair assistant and a sanitized diagnostics bundle that is only sent when you tap share. ```
#### 缺口 - 未实机比较远程与本地任务 **影响**：无法量化效率或需求强度 **进一步探讨**：选同一任务在手机与远程环境记录耗时及恢复。 ### Q02 · 屏幕范围和虚拟屏如何在源码中约束？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 screen-scope 默认 virtual-only，逐操作读取原生偏好；读取失败或值无效回到默认。桥接解析虚拟别名时要求注册表确认动态 displayId；未就绪不回退物理屏 0。屏幕范围仅覆盖可识别路径与判定，不证明任意 shell 或所有设备权限形成完整沙箱。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh-android-bridge/src/screen-scope.ts:3-9](https://github.com/kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk/blob/664376fde91af8a4cff3555a7d563ac999bc142f/plugins/dsh-android-bridge/src/screen-scope.ts#L3-L9) 默认范围和别名。 ```text /** User-owned, stable screen aliases exposed to model-facing Android tools. */ export type ScreenId = string export type UserScreenScope = 'virtual-only' | 'real-only' | 'all' export const DEFAULT_SCREEN_SCOPE: UserScreenScope = 'virtual-only' export const REAL_SCREEN_ID = 'real' export const VIRTUAL_SCREEN_ID = 'virtual-1' ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh-android-bridge/src/screen-scope.ts:1215-1255](https://github.com/kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk/blob/664376fde91af8a4cff3555a7d563ac999bc142f/plugins/dsh-android-bridge/src/screen-scope.ts#L1215-L1255) 偏好读取和未就绪规则。
查看原文（41行） ```text /** Normalize only the three product settings values; corrupt data fails closed. */ export function normalizeScreenScope(value: unknown): UserScreenScope { return value === 'virtual-only' || value === 'real-only' || value === 'all' ? value : DEFAULT_SCREEN_SCOPE } /** Parse the native ScreenScopePrefs XML without allowing an engine plugin to write that preference. */ export function parseScreenScopePrefsXml(xml: string): UserScreenScope { const match = /([^<]*)<\/string>/.exec(xml) return normalizeScreenScope(match?.[1]) } function scopePrefsPath(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): string | undefined { if (env.DSH_SCREEN_SCOPE_PREFS_PATH) return env.DSH_SCREEN_SCOPE_PREFS_PATH if (env.TERMUX__PREFIX && env.DSH_HOME) return SHELL_SCREEN_SCOPE_PREFS_DEFAULT return undefined } /** * Read the native preference afresh for each device operation. Test-only environment input is * intentionally gated, so a stale generic environment value cannot override the shell preference. */ export function currentScreenScope(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): UserScreenScope { if (env.DSH_SCREEN_SCOPE_TEST === '1' || env.DSH_SCREEN_SCOPE_TEST === 'true') { return normalizeScreenScope(env.DSH_SCREEN_SCOPE) } const path = scopePrefsPath(env) if (path === undefined) return DEFAULT_SCREEN_SCOPE try { return parseScreenScopePrefsXml(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')) } catch { return DEFAULT_SCREEN_SCOPE } } /** * Decide the executable physical/virtual-screen target for the user-owned scope. * * VirtualDisplay is deliberately not guessed from an Android numeric id: the alias must be resolved * through the native registry (`screens()` / `vdInfo`) and passed in via [ScreenAccessOptions]. * Without a resolved id, before the display is ready every virtual request fails explicitly * (`screen-not-ready`) — never a silent fallback to display 0 (U-3). ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh-android-bridge/src/index.ts:759-780](https://github.com/kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk/blob/664376fde91af8a4cff3555a7d563ac999bc142f/plugins/dsh-android-bridge/src/index.ts#L759-L780) 逐次读取及动态映射。
查看原文（22行） ```text /** Native user preference, read live; model code has no write surface for it. */ screenScope(): UserScreenScope { return currentScreenScope() } /** Fail-closed screen target decision shared by all real/virtual content tool paths. */ screenAccess(screenId?: string): ScreenAccessDecision { return decideScreenAccess(this.screenScope(), screenId) } /** * review C11 alias 契约：把 `virtual-1` 解析为**当次**动态 displayId（经壳侧 vdInfo 注册表）。 * 只认原生回报的 kind=virtual 且 displayId>0 的条目；未就绪/不可达一律 null（绝不回退 display 0）。 */ async resolveScreenDisplayId(screenId: string): Promise { if (screenId === 'real') return 0 if (!isVirtualScreenId(screenId)) return null try { const r = await this.controlExec('vdInfo', {}) if (!r.ok) return null const data = (r.data ?? {}) as { screens?: Array<{ alias?: string; displayId?: number; kind?: string }> } const hit = (data.screens ?? []).find((s) => s.alias === screenId && s.kind === 'virtual') ```
#### 缺口 - 未运行 native 注册表和全部命令路径 **影响**：不能证明边界在设备上无绕过 **进一步探讨**：隔离设备验证非法目标、注册表失效及原生命令复查。 ### Q03 · 权限、宿主和项目源码边界是什么？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 README 将虚拟显示标为实验性并要求 Shizuku；实屏操作需无障碍并扩大范围。权限选择器和远程 Web 均有各自交互边界，不能以默认虚拟屏视作系统级隔离证明。本次固定检出未见 Android Kotlin/Java 主工程，README 指明打包在协调仓库；不得由桥源码推断 APK 中原生端所有检查或实际表现。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[README.en.md:23-26](https://github.com/kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk/blob/664376fde91af8a4cff3555a7d563ac999bc142f/README.en.md#L23-L26) 设备能力与权限条件。 ```text - **Runs in the background, self-recovers**: lock the screen or switch apps and tasks keep running; the engine is watchdogged and relaunched when it wedges, and comes back on its own after a reboot. Background use drains more battery than an average app — allow "ignore battery optimizations" when the app guides you to. - **AI browser** (experimental): the AI opens and drives web pages in a separate window whose cookies and logins are fully isolated from your daily browser — it never touches your accounts. - **Virtual display** (experimental, needs Shizuku): the AI launches and operates third-party apps on a separate virtual screen without taking over yours, and you can watch it work in a floating window. - **Phone control**: after you grant accessibility, the AI can read the screen and tap, swipe, type and screenshot for you on a real phone. By default only the virtual screen is allowed — touching the real screen requires you to widen the scope in settings. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[README.en.md:78-87](https://github.com/kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk/blob/664376fde91af8a4cff3555a7d563ac999bc142f/README.en.md#L78-L87) 安装、权限与无障碍说明。
